Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
I will be at Gen*Con this year, so I probably won't have access
to the newsgroup and mailing list from Tuesday (tomorrow) afternoon
until the 11th (a week from today).

Try to save your questions until Monday, or be prepared to re-ask
them if you fail to stir up an adequate response from the usual
crowd (Bakija, Coupe, Goudie, Hamblin, Peterson, et. al.)
